a French pre-metric measurement of capacity or volume equal to 0.952 liters. Under the monarchy its size varied depending on the region, with the Parisian pinte being equivalent to 0.93 liters. 1 pinte (\"quart\") = 2 chopines (\"pint\") = 4 demiards (\"half-pint\")
